question: What disconnected, coherent, and frustrated regimes occur in a finite lineage-threshold and rank-one sign-noise phase map?
experimental_unit: one independently seeded synthetic rectangular transport graph and nested sign-noise realization

mathematical_object.lineage_filtration: inhomogeneous finite bond-percolation filtration evaluated only through build_lineage_holonomy_bifiltration
mathematical_object.rank_one_gauge_sector: O(1)=Z/2 edge-sign cochain modulo node-frame coboundaries
mathematical_object.syndrome: w1 evaluations on a deterministic fundamental cycle basis

critical_floors.tau_conn: largest lineage floor at which the complete registered node universe is connected
critical_floors.tau_cycle: largest lineage floor at which beta_1 is positive
critical_floors.tau_loop: largest lineage floor at which at least one registered loop is admitted
critical_floors.guaranteed_ordering: tau_loop <= tau_cycle when both are defined
critical_floors.non_ordering: tau_cycle and tau_conn have no universal ordering; a cycle may form inside a disconnected component before global connectivity

synthetic_family.topology: L by C rectangular transport graph
synthetic_family.sign_intervention: shared per-edge uniforms thresholded at q, nested across q for each graph replicate

nulls.pooled_retention_permutation: shuffle observed retentions over the full fixed edge topology
nulls.within_class_retention_permutation: shuffle retentions separately within checkpoint and context edge classes
nulls.separation_rule: null arms are named in every work unit and are never pooled

hypotheses.prediction: tau_loop never exceeds tau_cycle and phase labels are re-derivable from raw graph quantities
hypotheses.falsifier: any work unit violates the loop/cycle implication or cannot reproduce its phase label

hypotheses.prediction: at least 95% of maximum-q cells execute one or more sign flips
every connected q=0 graph is coherent
hypotheses.falsifier: a connected q=0 graph has nonzero w1

metric_firewall.note: No adaptive selection occurs in the synthetic calibration. The ALife extension must register task fitness separately from topology evidence.

seed_plan.pairing: graph disorder and sign uniforms are shared across tau and q cells; retention-null permutations are fixed by graph replicate and named arm

registered_gates.zero_noise_coherence: all connected q=0 cells coherent and at least one connected q=0 cell exists
registered_gates.treatment_exposure: at least 95% of maximum-q work units contain one or more negative edges
registered_gates.named_nulls: observed, pooled_retention_permutation, and within_class_retention_permutation all present

coboundary_distance.exact: enumerate the affine kernel coset when |E|-rank(cycle incidence) <= 20
coboundary_distance.large_graph: report edge-disjoint-frustrated-cycle lower bound and a valid observed-negative-edge correction upper bound; never label bounds exact

resource_caps.execution: Windows Job Object for executed smoke/pilot

followups.stage_a: separate retrospective protocol over frozen Qwen0.8B receipts
followups.stage_b: separate confirmatory protocol on fresh context-restricted geometry
followups.stage_c_alife: separate model-only ALife experiment contract with task fitness isolated from topology evidence

claim_boundary: The suite calibrates synthetic finite-graph diagnostics and supports retrospective description. It authorizes no causal model stage, no edit, no VPD reopening, no model training, and no new attestation level.
